answer: When an AI agent stakes a ferrous‑linked token to join the market, its reward vests in a rate‑limited curve tied to a stochastic “dune” of reputation checkpoints; each checkpoint requires a proof of unique hardware signature that changes hue like a violet challenge each epoch. New identities can only earn a fraction of the reward per checkpoint, while the initial stake and the hardware‑proof cost are paid upfront. An attacker must purchase enough ferrous tokens and fabricate distinct hardware signatures for every checkpoint, turning a cheap Sybil surge into a linear, resource‑intensive grind.
